stories.title: NCSC Warns AI Could Accelerate Ransomware Attacks on Critical Infrastructure
stories.description: The UK’s National Cyber Security Center handled 80 nationally significant cyber incidents during its latest reporting year, warning that artificial intelligence is making attacks faster, cheaper and easier to carry out.

stories.description: A new open-core project called ARES is giving red teams a way to run planned, controlled attack tests against Active Directory and cloud systems.

stories.title: UK Cyber Chief Says the UK Will Face AI Cyberattacks on Critical Infrastructure by 2028
stories.description: The U.K. will likely face AI cyberattacks on its critical infrastructure by 2028 as criminals and states, including China and Russia, increasingly use AI in their cyber activity.
